T0551.title: PIA
T0551.definition: A privacy impact assessment used to identify privacy risks in a product, service, or data-processing activity.
T0551.description: A PIA identifies privacy impact before a product or data-processing activity launches, covering collection necessity, purpose, sharing, user rights, and retention. It turns privacy risk into design constraints and control requirements, especially for new features, data sharing, profiling, and third-party integrations.
T0551.usageExample: Assess PIA related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
